policy: Local interpretation of linked guidance, not Google's ranking rules. This matrix does not override validator gates or generate review decisions.

profiles.article: Resolve the reader's question with accurate explanation and an identifiable contribution. Do not require a sales CTA, experiments, a FAQ or a fixed length.
profiles.landing: Explain the real purpose, audience, fit and appropriate next step. An educational landing can have no commercial CTA. Organizational responsibility can replace an individual byline.
profiles.draft: Review supplied content and evidence. Do not infer rendered behavior, live availability, indexability or final CMS metadata.
profiles.staging: Review emitted metadata and rendered behavior with actual evidence. Respect declared staging indexing restrictions; do not require public exposure.
profiles.live: Require actual observations for live checks; availability does not prove indexing or ranking. Reassess changed content and evidence.

rules.when: Assess the creator or publisher's relevant reputation; limited recognition is not adverse evidence.
evidence: Research scope, entity match and relevant independent records, including an honest no-results record
rules.exception: Do not require public reviews, traffic or backlinks from a new organization.
rules.limit: A draft or domain score cannot establish external reputation.

rules.when: Evaluate the independence and relevance of evidence offered as authority.
evidence: Original endorsements and material relationships between the parties
rules.exception: Owned descriptions and genuine customer accounts can be useful without being independent expert proof.
rules.limit: Source count and citation presence do not establish independence.

rules.when: Every page needs a risk-scope decision, even when brief.ymyl is false.
evidence: Actual recommendations, potential harm and topic-appropriate competence
rules.exception: A mention of money or health is not automatically specialist advice; a false YMYL flag is not an exemption.
rules.limit: The declaration cannot classify risk or authenticate a qualified reviewer.

rules.when: At staging/live, assess prominence and usability of the actual rendered main content.
evidence: Rendered reading and interaction observations for the current version
rules.exception: A draft-stage exclusion is not a finding that the eventual layout is usable.
rules.limit: Static HTML cannot establish obstruction, layout or visual prominence.

rules.when: Every substantive article or landing needs an identifiable reader benefit.
evidence: Specific contribution and relevant comparison with sources or sibling pages
rules.exception: An article explains; a landing establishes purpose, fit and substantiated scope. They need not share a template.
rules.limit: Length, citations, media and polish are not originality evidence.

rules.when: Assess completeness and focus against the actual reader task.
evidence: Brief-to-content comparison and material questions resolved or omitted
rules.exception: A short landing can be complete; no universal word count, keyword density or FAQ requirement.
rules.limit: Counting sections cannot demonstrate satisfaction of intent.

rules.when: Verify honest, context-appropriate responsibility and any identity claims.
evidence: Actual creator, publisher or responsible organization records supporting visible attribution
rules.exception: An organization can author a landing; a named individual or author box is not mandatory everywhere.
rules.limit: A byline, schema or portrait does not authenticate a person.

rules.when: Judge trust and competence in relation to purpose, claims and risk.
evidence: Relevant experience, technical support and ownership evidence
rules.exception: Practical competence can be relevant without a formal degree.
rules.limit: No numeric E-E-A-T score or ranking prediction is supported.

rules.when: The current gate opens when brief.updated is true; also inspect undeclared time-sensitive claims contextually.
evidence: Substantive revision history and applicable versions or effective dates
rules.exception: Stable information does not require cosmetic date changes. A false flag cannot excuse an evidenced freshness failure.
rules.limit: The flag cannot discover undisclosed updates; CLAIM-002 and TRUST-04 still require contextual review.

rules.when: Assess suspected scaled content against its value and production purpose.
evidence: Relevant collection, production context and substantive contribution comparisons
rules.exception: AI use, volume and shared templates do not alone establish scaled content abuse.
rules.limit: One page and a similarity score cannot establish collection-level abuse; missing comparison remains unresolved.

rules.when: Review suspected doorway intent and distinct utility across related pages.
evidence: Sibling-page inventory, destinations, hierarchy and audience differences
rules.exception: Reusable components and design templates are not themselves doorway abuse.
rules.limit: No collection-wide conclusion from a single isolated draft.

rules.when: Review incentives and link qualification when links or endorsements could be promotional.
evidence: Link purpose, compensation context and actual qualification attributes
rules.exception: Not all outbound links are sponsored; a documented absence of relevant links can support a contextual exception.
rules.limit: Link volume cannot prove paid placement or qualified demand.

rules.when: Live stage only: verify the actual response for the intended URL.
evidence: Current imported HTTP/browser observation bound to content and context
rules.exception: Draft/staging exclusion does not establish availability. Do not expose staging to satisfy this check.
rules.limit: HTTP 200 alone cannot establish indexing, rankings or content quality.

rules.when: Live stage only: compare accessibility and indexing restrictions with declared intent.
evidence: Current response, robots/indexing observations and declared URL intent
rules.exception: An intentional restriction is evaluated against its purpose, not treated as permission to expose private content.
rules.limit: No live evidence means not_tested, not pass or not_applicable.

rules.when: JSON-LD, microdata or supported RDFa markers occur in the supplied content.
evidence: Emitted markup, corresponding visible content and feature-specific policy support
rules.exception: Schema is not universally required; absent markup can exclude this rule but cannot hide an evidenced failure.
rules.limit: Valid syntax is not truth, complete feature validation or rich-result eligibility.

rules.when: Review claimed readiness for Google AI search against ordinary supported search guidance.
evidence: Actual claims and applicable Search Central guidance, plus stage-appropriate technical evidence
rules.exception: Do not invent a special AI file, schema requirement or guaranteed AI citation.
rules.limit: Local review cannot establish inclusion in AI results.

rules.when: The brief claims video-search eligibility; examine whether the intended page is a relevant watch page.
evidence: Eligibility claim, page purpose, video placement and current rendered/live evidence where needed
rules.exception: An embedded supporting video is not automatically a watch-page or video-indexing claim.
rules.limit: The flag may miss undeclared promises; an explicit evidenced failure still survives a scope conflict.

rules.when: Review navigation destinations and interaction relevant to the reader's task.
evidence: Actual anchors, intended targets and reachability or interaction evidence when claimed
rules.exception: A page with no relevant navigation may justify an evidenced contextual exception; syntax alone cannot verify a target.
rules.limit: Static parsing does not visit destinations or establish indexing.

rules.when: Assess internal links for contextual usefulness and discovery.
evidence: Relevant content inventory, actual link context and destination purpose
rules.exception: No universal link quota; an absence of useful related material can justify no additional internal links.
rules.limit: Counting anchors does not establish relevance or authority transfer.

rules.when: Assess heading meaning and hierarchy for the actual reading structure.
evidence: Heading outline and the content each heading introduces
rules.exception: Developer house style does not dictate landing-page rhetoric; logical structure is distinct from visual size.
rules.limit: Heading presence is not comprehension or a ranking signal measurement.

rules.when: Images occur and need context-appropriate alternatives or explanation.
evidence: Actual image purpose, surrounding content and alternative text or equivalent explanation
rules.exception: Decorative images may have empty alt; complex charts may need a nearby explanation rather than oversized alt.
rules.limit: Alt presence cannot establish accuracy, usefulness or full accessibility.

rules.when: Assess clarity and tone using the actual audience and approved brand voice.
evidence: Brand brief, representative passages and concrete comprehension or repetition defects
rules.exception: Google developer-documentation style is contextual advice, not a universal marketing voice or prohibited-word list.
rules.limit: A style disagreement alone is not evidence of a ranking penalty.

rules.when: Every bundle must supply the local contract's explicit brief fields.
evidence: Bundle fields, types and scope declarations
rules.exception: No receipt can waive an automatic failure; optional commercial CTA absence should be documented, not fabricated.
rules.limit: Field completeness does not verify business facts or a useful purpose.

rules.when: Every review HTML document includes its intended visible main h1.
evidence: Supplied HTML and intended main title
rules.exception: This is a local review-input convention, not Google's universal one-h1 ranking requirement.
rules.limit: Static presence does not establish final CMS rendering.

rules.when: Check headings present in every supplied document for nonempty names.
evidence: Heading markup and accessible text recognized by the parser
rules.exception: No automatic-failure waiver; repair empty structure instead of styling around it.
rules.limit: A named heading can still be misleading; semantic review remains separate.

rules.when: Check the supplied heading sequence for skipped levels under local policy.
evidence: Actual heading sequence
rules.exception: Severity remains warning; a local sequence convention is not a Google ranking rule.
rules.limit: The heuristic cannot establish the best editorial structure.

rules.when: Every draft must contain readable substantive text rather than an empty shell.
evidence: Visible text recognized in the supplied HTML
rules.exception: JavaScript that might render later is not supplied review content.
rules.limit: Text existence does not establish indexability, accuracy or usefulness.

rules.when: img elements occur in the supplied document.
evidence: Image markup and presence of alt attributes
rules.exception: Empty alt is valid for decorative images; absence of img excludes this narrow check.
rules.limit: Does not classify decoration, check image loading or judge alt quality.

rules.when: Anchor elements occur; check navigation href syntax under local policy.
evidence: Raw anchor attributes
rules.exception: Use buttons for actions; no receipt can excuse invalid static navigation. Hidden anchors are still inspected.
rules.limit: A syntactically usable href does not establish reachability or safety.

rules.when: Anchors occur; inspect local fragment targets where the narrow check recognizes them.
evidence: Fragment hrefs and target IDs in the supplied HTML
rules.exception: No local-fragment defect can be claimed when no local fragment is tested; hidden anchors remain inspected.
rules.limit: Does not resolve script-generated or remote document targets.

rules.when: Exposed navigation anchors need a name; HTML-hidden ancestors are excluded from this static name check.
evidence: Actual exposed markup, recognized name sources and activated-state evidence separately
rules.exception: HTML-hidden exclusion is narrow; aria-hidden alone does not excuse a focusable unnamed link.
rules.limit: Does not implement complete accessible-name computation, CSS visibility or browser interaction.

rules.when: application/ld+json blocks occur.
evidence: Exact JSON-LD text, duplicate-key and root-type parsing results
rules.exception: No JSON-LD means no syntax check, not a demand to add schema.
rules.limit: Does not validate semantic truth, microdata or feature eligibility.

rules.when: Staging/live page output must contain one nonempty title under local policy.
evidence: Actual head output for the named version and stage
rules.exception: Draft exclusion does not approve future CMS metadata.
rules.limit: Presence and count do not prove title accuracy or Google title selection.

rules.when: Staging/live page output needs a nonempty description under local policy.
evidence: Emitted description metadata
rules.exception: Warning severity remains unchanged; this local requirement is not a guarantee of Google's snippet.
rules.limit: Presence does not establish relevance or snippet use.

rules.when: Staging/live emitted canonical must match declared intent.
evidence: Brief canonical and emitted canonical elements
rules.exception: Drafts need not pretend to have a deployed canonical; known conflicts are not waived by a flag.
rules.limit: Matching markup cannot prove Google's chosen canonical.

rules.when: Staging/live meta directives must agree with explicit indexing intent.
evidence: Emitted robots meta directives and brief indexing declaration
rules.exception: A staging noindex can be intentional; do not force every stage to be indexable.
rules.limit: Does not fetch HTTP headers, robots.txt or indexing status.

rules.when: Every bundle's claim ledger must reference actual draft quotes and known evidence IDs.
evidence: Exact normalized quotations, ledger and evidence references
rules.exception: An empty ledger is not proof that no material claims were omitted; CLAIM-003 reviews completeness.
rules.limit: Reference integrity is not factual support or causal validity.

rules.when: Every bundle's evidence records must have the required provenance and available files.
evidence: Evidence identifiers, files, origin, title and capture dates
rules.exception: No invented evidence to satisfy required fields; incomplete records remain defects.
rules.limit: File existence and ISO dates do not authenticate evidence or establish currency.

rules.when: Staging/live page output needs an html language declaration under local policy.
evidence: Emitted html language attribute
rules.exception: Draft exclusion does not certify deployed accessibility; warning severity remains unchanged.
rules.limit: Does not verify language accuracy or full localization.

rules.when: Review whether material claims are actually supported in context.
evidence: Source passages, contradictions, relevant dates and the exact claim scope
rules.exception: Opinions and clearly labeled projections differ from historical outcomes; assumptions still need support.
rules.limit: The agent must assess entailment; neither attached files nor existing IDs prove truth.

rules.when: Compare the complete copy with its material claim ledger, especially numbers and promises.
evidence: All decision-relevant claims, measurement definitions and ledger mapping
rules.exception: Not every sentence needs a citation, but an empty ledger cannot exempt numeric results or guarantees.
rules.limit: No automated discovery of every unsupported claim is implemented.

rules.when: Images, video, audio or iframes occur; review rights and relevant attribution.
evidence: Licenses, permissions, ownership or applicable use basis for actual assets
rules.exception: No detected media excludes this gate, not an evidenced rights failure elsewhere in the supplied review.
rules.limit: Markup cannot establish licensing or legal permission.

rules.when: Images, video, audio or iframes occur; assess their accuracy and explanatory role.
evidence: Actual rendered assets, data sources and surrounding explanation
rules.exception: Media is optional; decorative assets need not teach, and their presence does not establish authority.
rules.limit: No pixel, video or diagram-content analysis is performed by the CLI.

rules.when: Staging/live title and description must accurately represent the visible page.
evidence: Emitted metadata, actual copy and support for promises
rules.exception: A draft-stage exclusion leaves final metadata review outstanding for deployment.
rules.limit: Static syntax checks cannot establish semantic consistency.

rules.when: Staging/live needs actual keyboard and visual review for relevant reading and interactions.
evidence: Current rendered keyboard, responsive-layout and interaction observations
rules.exception: A draft exclusion is not accessibility conformance; intentional no-CTA education does not require a form.
rules.limit: No browser capture or comprehensive conformance audit is executed.

rules.when: Every page's outcome and next action must fit its purpose, audience and brand.
evidence: Brief, actual copy and intended reader outcome or action
rules.exception: Education/community pages can intentionally omit contact or lead capture; do not invent an offer or form.
rules.limit: CTA presence cannot demonstrate persuasion, conversion or reader satisfaction.

criteria.not_applicable_when: No general exemption: every substantive page needs a purpose assessment.
No exemption from risk-scope assessment; low risk can support a pass, not a skipped scope review.
A documented content review finds no claimed first-hand use, delivery, testing or personal result.
No claim or recommendation relies on testing, benchmarking or comparative evaluation; record the actual basis used.
No recommendation generalizes from observations or case outcomes; missing limits on a real generalization are not an exception.
The scoped content neither relies on specialist competence nor claims professional capability; risk assessment still applies.
No material factual, technical or advisory statement occurs, as evidenced by a complete content review.
The page makes no conceptual, process, comparison or service explanation; a short explanation is still in scope.
A justified scope decision excludes a reputation assessment; missing recognition alone is not a negative result or an exemption.
No testimonial, endorsement, award or media recognition is presented as proof.
The distinction is not relevant after documented reputation review; incomplete research remains unknown, not an exception.
No general exemption from honest responsibility; organizational attribution can satisfy the criterion.
No decision-relevant statistics, results, comparisons or promises appear after review of the whole copy.
No material endorsement, recommendation or relationship can affect interpretation; ordinary own-offer positioning is not automatically deceptive.
No update representation or time-sensitive assertion requires a currency decision; age alone is not a defect.
The review artifact has no relevant metadata or schema and final output is outside the named scope; do not claim final-output consistency.
No connected data-collection, transaction or support flow is promised or used; an educational page need not add one.
No general exemption: every substantive page needs an identifiable useful contribution.
Production method cannot materially affect interpretation and no unverified research, testing or review account is asserted; do not infer this from an AI detector.
Only final rendered assessment is outside a draft's explicit scope; missing rendered evidence at staging/live remains unresolved.
